reasons: I love how you make even ordinary moments feel special.
I love your kind heart and the way you care for the people around you.
I love that I can be completely myself when I am with you.

paragraphs: Some people make life louder. You make mine feel more like home. I love the way your smile can change the whole mood of an ordinary day, and the way even the smallest moments with you become memories I want to keep.
Thank you for being wonderfully, completely you. I hope this little world reminds you how loved you are, today and on every day that comes after it.
Happy birthday to my favourite person. I am so lucky that I get to keep choosing you, in all the little moments and all the big ones.

gift.title: A year of little adventures
gift.description: Your real present is a promise: more dates, more ridiculous photos, more food runs, more places to discover, and more ordinary days made special together.
